RESEARCH TOWARD FEWER THAN 208 STATES
29 October 2026 — prepared for Vladimir Reshetnikov

OUTCOME
No validated machine with 207 states or fewer was obtained. This archive is
an audited comparison and reproducible research contribution, not a new207
construction or a state-count lower bound. The retained208 machine is credited
to the incoming proposals, not presented as a new result.

The five submissions in the two user-specified commits contain nine literal
208-state tables but only TWO rooted transition-graph isomorphism classes.
All use the same conditional-history identification of the172/211 roles;
there is no independent deletion to stack across these submissions.

INPUT PINS
Initial: ef5a23e04b0285e321ceec5f4b329223cee0ab57
Late:    34aaab66fc5dc834863ed00ea84823c93b8c5b1e
Repository: https://github.com/VladimirReshetnikov/ProveIt
Archive SHA256 and Git blob identities are in provenance/. Exact selected
literal tables, source snapshots and conjugacy maps are in comparison/.

NEW RESEARCH
* Source-boundary projection supplies sound overapproximating seven-cell
  guards from complete arbitrary-natural symbolic primitive contracts,
  including compressed unary/list interiors and exact blank startup.
* A head-offset quotient lemma permits a different head position at merged
  control boundaries, including initialization by blank-tape translation.
* Whole closed-loop pruning preserves source control flow under checked zero
  guards, but fewer primitive occurrences worsen the existing shared-tree
  representation:3909->3904 leaves,197->200 distinct syntactic DAG nodes.
* Deeper-history, neutral-helper, offset, two-row, source-window and guarded
  layout searches are negative within their explicitly stated finite scopes.

REPLAY (Python3.10+, standard library)
From the extracted root:
    python3 -B reproduce.py --receipt /tmp/below-u208-replay.json
The default is FULL: both inherited208 graph classes are rederived through
all5,084 symbolic contracts; both new boundary projections are rebuilt; the
bounded selector/offset synthesis family is rerun; applicable independent
finite checks also run under Python-O. Four independent jobs may run in
parallel. Temporary files are outside the sealed package. Assertions must
remain enabled for symbolic induction. A finite search is not a kernel proof.

For an explicitly incomplete, faster check:
    python3 -B reproduce.py --quick
This skips full runtime/projection derivations and the offset-neutral search.
It does NOT establish that those skipped stages passed. The much larger
local merge and source-layout discovery runs are retained as hashed terminal
receipts and optional scripts; neither default mode reruns every such search.
Each subdirectory README specifies its exact replay scope.

reference/     Original unmodified Conditional_Context208 ZIP, retaining the
               complete parent/calibration lineage and notices.
comparison/    Nine exact table/source snapshots and two-class proof checks.

Only the Conditional_Context208 incoming archive is retained in full. Other
incoming archives are represented by pinned selected bytes, licenses and
exact comparison maps, not described as fully bundled.
The outer replay rejects changed, missing and extra files and checks that its
sealed payload remains unchanged. It writes the final receipt outside this
archive to avoid a self-referential seal.

TRUST BOUNDARY
The Con(U)/Con(PA) calibration is inherited from the supplied construction
lineage. This work adds ordinary mathematical arguments and executable finite
or symbolic checks, not a new end-to-end Lean/Rocq/MM0 certificate or exported
PA derivation. No unconditional nonhalting, global minimality, historical
priority or semantic impossibility of rejected bounded templates is claimed.

SEARCHING BELOW 208 STATES: COMPARATIVE AUDIT AND REDUCTION SEARCH
29 October 2026

RESULT AND LIMIT
================
This dossier does NOT establish a 207-state consistency machine. The requested
later commits already supply 208-state machines. The research here compares and
checks those constructions, extends the reduction search, and proves a new
obstruction to one tempting logical simplification. No rejected or unchecked
table is promoted to an accepted smaller machine.

Read paper/report.pdf; edit paper/report.tex and its three small included TeX
files. The report contains the mathematical arguments, exact comparison, search
scope, verification status, and further research questions.

================

The five newer U208 packets give nine presentations of only TWO classes. Every
U208 packet uses the same conditional-history 172/211 identification. They
cannot be combined into an additional deletion. Exact source/table snapshots,
forced bijections, source CFG checks and hashes are included.

NEW RESEARCH IN THIS DOSSIER
===========================
1. A two-element finite model shows that globally identifying the cover emitter's
   source and output roles collapses its intended arithmetic strength. PA proves
   consistency of the collapsed theory, so, if PA is consistent, it cannot retain
   the required PA-provable consistency biconditional with PA.
2. Exact exhaustion of all 279,936 independent parameter permutations in seven
   unrestricted axiom rows gives minimum source DAG size 197, with exactly four
   minimizers. Association and other source instructions are fixed. This is not
   a physical-state lower bound.
3. Both outgoing keeper rows were synthesized over all 21,528 unordered state
   pairs in each 208-state class, including the start-state pairs. Depth 12 and
   bound 71 runs gave no survivor; the same algorithm recovers the known U209
   fold as a positive control. A stronger source-conditioned Class A run also
   gives no survivor.
4. Correlated zero/positive and interval source invariants, all-spares-one
   specialized runtime contracts, row-order/association experiments, and
   shifted-head searches extend the discovery scope. Their exact bounds and
   evidence are in the report and research subdirectories.

FRESH BASELINE VERIFICATION
==========================
Each final U208 class was freshly checked over arbitrary register values:
  Class A: 5,084 guarded contracts, 1,251,865 symbolic inferences, 416/416 rows.
  Class B: 5,084 guarded contracts, 1,250,564 symbolic inferences, 416/416 rows.
The exact 48,140-step blank startup is preserved. All 14 native/dense comparison
presentations were checked, including the older U209 data.

These are ordinary mathematical/inductive executable certificates. The inherited
U/PA calibration is not replaced by a new exported PA, Lean, Rocq, or MM0 proof
object. Finite blank execution is not being used as a nonhalting proof.

OFFLINE REPRODUCTION
===================

  python3 -B verify.py --output /tmp/conpa-dossier-finite.json

It EXPLICITLY does not rerun the full universal runtimes or long discovery jobs.

Allow several minutes. Do not use Python -O for the inherited full symbolic

# PA194R: a different 194-state PA consistency machine

**Result:** No machine below 194 states was verified. The primary fallback is
**PA194R**, a new decoder layout combined with a proved known-zero closing
decrement. It has 194 working states, two symbols, one two-way tape, an all-zero
initial tape, and only L/R moves. The halt state is excluded from the count.

The ordinary mathematical result is:

    PA proves: (PA194R never halts from blank) iff Con(PA).

This package supplies an ordinary mathematical proof and complete finite and
universal symbolic verification, with the inherited proof-producing logical
calibration explicitly retained. It does **not** claim a new end-to-end Lean or
Rocq theorem, or either missing machine-specific iPRA reduction in the upstream
project. Actual nonhalting in the standard model follows if PA is consistent.

## What is new

PA194R changes **1,111 of 3,646 source-address paths**, replacing 44 of the
67 axiom-reader subtree types while keeping 23. Its resolved instruction graph
is exactly that of the simpler new PA194F. Both replace the emitter's final
unconditional return with decrement X. A four-site invariant proves X is zero
there and gives exact equality with the supplied PA194CS source execution.

The 196-state research already contains the general zero-closing principle.
The new contribution is this verified 194-state composition and reassociated
decoder, its literal tables, the small proof and the independent physical
checks. The four new graphs are mutually distinct and absent from the eight
old 194-state classes in the recognized pinned corpus, even allowing state
renamings, root changes, reflection and global bit exchange.

| Directory | Change from supplied PA194CS | Clean startup |
|---|---|---:|
| `machines/PA194R` | New 67-reader grammar, seven AX folds, controller fold, final X decrement | 57,768 steps |
| `machines/PA194F` | Final emitter jump becomes decrement X; simple one-row intermediate | 57,768 steps |
| `machines/PA194A` | Entry jump at source 26 becomes decrement A | 57,978 steps |
| `machines/PA194X` | Entry jump at source 26 becomes decrement X | 58,014 steps |

Each has 194 controls, 388 rows, 3,646 source sites and 4,746 checked outcomes.
Both outcomes of every decrement are checked, including the new unreachable
positive branch.

A 195-STATE PA CONSISTENCY TURING MACHINE
========================================

Primary result: machine_195S.tm
  195 working states, numbered 0..194; initial state 0; terminal halt 195.
  Two-way infinite binary tape, initially all 0; head initially at cell 0.
  Every row is: current_state read_bit write_bit direction next_state.
  Write, then move L or R, then enter the next state. Halt has no rows.
  There are 390 transitions. The halt control is excluded from 195.

MATHEMATICAL RESULT
  PA proves Nonhalt(machine_195S) <-> Con(PA), by the finite-trace
  preservation theorem in report.pdf and the inherited calibration of the
  supplied separate-diagonal-head 196-state parent. The source program is
  exactly unchanged; 67 AX readers replace 68, retaining six compatible
  folds: 134+67-6=195. No axiom, head order, parameter assignment, guard,
  stack position, command semantics, or scheduler changes.

  This archive provides an ordinary mathematical proof and executable
  finite/symbolic certificates. It does not claim a new end-to-end Lean
  theorem. The imported arithmetic-box interfaces and existing logical
  calibration are explicitly identified in the report and source files.

This archive is a completed comparison and a reproducible record of further
experiments. It is **not** a claimed solution to the requested strict state
reduction. It contains no new theorem establishing the PA consistency
biconditional for a machine with at most 195 states.

Start with `report/pa_consistency_reduction_report.pdf`. Its editable source is
`report/pa_consistency_reduction_report.tex`, with two included TeX tables.

## Target and conventions

The investigated target is a deterministic binary, single-tape Turing machine,
started on an all-zero two-way infinite tape. All transitions move left or right.
The state count excludes one separate halting control. The requested logical
endpoint is

    PA proves: nonhalting(T, blank) iff Con(PA).

A complete table, a finite startup simulation, a source equivalence, symbolic
instruction checks, an external Lean theorem, and an internal PA theorem are
different forms of evidence. The report identifies which are supplied.

## Machine convention

Each transition line is `state read write direction next_state`. The tape is
two-way infinite and initially all zero. The head starts at any fixed origin in
state **0**. Working states are **0 through 198**. State **199** is the halt label
and has no rows. Each step writes 0 or 1 and moves exactly one cell left (`L`) or
right (`R`). The halt label is excluded from the 199-state count.

The native presentation starts in state 74, uses decoder root 84, and halts at
254. Native labels are identifiers, not a count. The dense table's SHA-256 is:
